meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用命令行指令编排视频内容,自动完成渲染与发布
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望用脚本化方式制作和渲染视频,不想依赖图形界面。
copy.tagline_en: Create and render videos via command line, from keyframes to cloud targets.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you prefer scripted video work over manual editing.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会通过 HyperFrames 命令行帮你搭建视频合成项目、从本地动画目录挑选现成效果、检查并渲染成 mp4 文件;构建或渲染失败时也会用该 CLI 诊断。
howto.when: 当你说要制作或修改视频、挑选动画效果、渲染成片,或遇到构建/渲染报错需要诊断时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 HyperFrames 初始化一个新视频项目
say.note: 会运行 init 命令搭建项目骨架

say.text: 在目录里搜一个逐行揭示标题的效果
say.note: 调用 catalog 搜索本地动画素材

say.text: 用高清画质渲染项目,输出到 out.mp4
say.note: 运行 check 和 render 生成视频

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude uses the HyperFrames CLI to scaffold video composition projects, search a local catalog for existing effects, check and render MP4 output; it also uses the CLI to diagnose build or render failures.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to create or edit a video, look up an animation effect, render a final file, or when diagnosing build or render errors.

say_en.text: Set up a new HyperFrames video project for me.
say_en.note: Runs init to scaffold the project.

say_en.text: Search the catalog for a headline reveal effect.
say_en.note: Calls catalog to find a matching motion.

say_en.text: Render the project as a high-quality MP4.
say_en.note: Runs check then render to produce output.
